theme_and_identity.name: CareAI
theme_and_identity.vibe: Warm, friendly, accessible, and highly reassuring.
theme_and_identity.archetype: ARCHETYPE 3: PASTEL & SOFT with a functional twist.
theme_and_identity.description: A health dashboard that feels less like a sterile clinic and more like a helpful friend. It uses heavy glassmorphism, hyper-rounded corners, pastel colors, and floating 'sticker' illustrations to reduce health-related anxiety while keeping critical functions like the SOS button highly visible.

typography.strategy: The 'Soft Utility' - Friendly rounded headings paired with a highly readable, approachable body font.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3, and major widget numbers. Gives the 'sticker' and playful vibe.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, labels, lists, and UI text.

typography.instruction: Import Fredoka and Nunito from Google Fonts in index.html. DO NOT use Inter or Roboto.

background.description: Warm off-white/cream, never pure white to reduce eye strain.

primary.description: Pastel Rose. Used for primary friendly actions, AI chatbot accents, and highlighted states.

secondary.description: Soft Pastel Blue. Used for secondary cards, quick actions, and relaxing UI elements.

accent.description: Soft Lavender. Used for the AI Chatbot identity and avatar.

destructive.description: Signal Red. EXCLUSIVELY for the SOS Emergency button and destructive actions. Must stand out.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Mandatory for the main dashboard cards and AI chatbot window. Use `bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/60`. Ensures the pastel background bleeds through softly.
visual_enhancers.borders_and_radius: Hyper-rounded. Use `rounded-3xl` for main cards, `rounded-2xl` for internal elements, `rounded-full` for buttons. No sharp edges anywhere.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient, tinted shadows. e.g., `shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(253,164,175,0.15)]` on primary buttons.
visual_enhancers.stickers_concept: Place small floating 3D images (absolute positioned, rotated slightly) on the edges of cards to act as 'stickers'. e.g., a pill sticker on the medicine card.

sos_button.style: fixed bottom-6 right-6 w-16 h-16 sm:w-20 sm:h-20 rounded-full bg-red-500 shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(239,68,68,0.6)] flex items-center justify-center z-50 text-white font-black text-xl border-4 border-white/50
sos_button.animation: Pulse animation `animate-pulse` or a custom heartbeat scale. Must be hyper-visible.

cards.style: Use the glassmorphism surface. Internal padding must be generous: `p-6` or `p-8`.

ai_chatbot.layout: Floating window or dedicated view with Lavender accents.
ai_chatbot.bubbles: User: solid pastel blue (`bg-blue-100 rounded-3xl rounded-tr-sm`). AI: glassmorphism white (`bg-white/80 rounded-3xl rounded-tl-sm`).
ai_chatbot.disclaimer: Must be prominently displayed at the top of the chat in a muted yellow/orange pastel banner.

symptom_checker.chips: Multi-select rounded-full pills. Unselected: `bg-white border-slate-200`. Selected: `bg-rose-200 border-rose-300 text-rose-900`.

leaflet_map.container: Must be clipped inside a `rounded-3xl` container with `overflow-hidden` and a thick `border-4 border-white`.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento-style. `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6`. Welcome banner spanning full width. Health summary `col-span-8`, Quick actions `col-span-4`.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Extremely generous. Sections should be separated by `gap-8` or `my-12`. Never cramp information, especially for health data.

motion.transitions: All buttons need `transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 duration-200`.
motion.entrances: Staggered fade-up for dashboard cards using Framer Motion (`initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}`).
motion.decorative: Floating 'stickers' should have a very slow, infinite `translate-y` up/down floating animation.

images.description: Pastel abstract 3D shapes. Extract or use as a background texture/sticker in the Hero/Welcome widget.
3D pink heart object. Use as a 'sticker' illustration in the Disease Risk Predictors (Heart) or Health Summary card.
Pink and white pills. Use as a cropped image or thumbnail for the Medicine Reminder section.
Friendly doctor portrait. Use in the AI Chatbot avatar area (if making a persona) or Doctor Contacts section.

media.icons: Use `lucide-react`. Make them thick (strokeWidth={2.5}) and colorful (don't leave them gray). Wrap them in circular pastel backgrounds.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pastel backgrounds have sufficient contrast with text. Use dark slate/navy text, NEVER white text on pastel backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings should be `focus:ring-4 focus:ring-rose-200 focus:outline-none`.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='sos-button'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use generic clean-tech looks. Stick rigidly to the Pastel + Stickers + Glassmorphism concept requested by the user.
Ensure `lucide-react` icons are styled to look friendly (thick strokes, pastel wrappers).
Use Framer Motion to make the 'stickers' (images) literally float slowly up and down.
The SOS button is an absolute critical feature. Make it a fixed button on the bottom right, big, red, glowing, and ensure it uses `a` tags with `tel:` or `sms:` protocols.
Implement glassmorphism globally for cards over a slightly warm, off-white background.
For the Map, use OpenStreetMap with `react-leaflet`. Clip it nicely inside rounded corners.
For AI Chatbot, do not make it look like a terminal or standard ChatGPT. It should feel like a cozy, friendly iMessage thread with a cute Avatar.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical bento grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped, high border-radius).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use proper Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
